title: Hurricane (Anvil Aerospace, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Hurricane is a two-seat heavy fighter from Anvil Aerospace in Star Citizen. The pilot sits in front and a gunner works the turret behind. The pilot uses the common controls.

panels.name: Hurricane: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Hurricane's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (two)
controls.text: The pilot of the Hurricane has two guns of his own. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (four missiles)
controls.text: The Hurricane carries four missiles. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Hurricane: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Hurricane besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Manned turret
controls.text: The gunner's seat sits behind the pilot. There the gunner aims the turret with the right stick.
controls.context: A turret seat has its own controls: there the right stick aims the turret instead of steering the ship.
